integrity: The proof identifies every round color with a typed pair of clipped center/leaf distances, then separates within-leg and cross-length bottlenecks. The fixed-order extremal follows from a sharp counting bound and explicit extremizers. A standalone checker independently verifies the descriptor law and formulas over broad finite ranges.
scientific limitations: The theorem treats ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring on spider trees with at least three legs.
Paths and trees with more than one branch point are outside scope.
The finite checker covers 7942 leg multisets and 54 fixed-order extremal cases; the infinite theorem rests on the descriptor proof.
The literature search was targeted rather than exhaustive, and no independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of spider trees
